title: DOMAIN-NEUTRAL CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE SHEET
scaffold_guide_lines: FILL ONLY WHITE EDITABLE INTERIORS. KEEP LABELS, BORDERS, PROFILE FACTS, COLOR KEY, AND PROTECTED PANELS UNCHANGED.
DRAW ONE CONSISTENT IDENTITY OR COLLECTIVE. PRESERVE DECLARED TOPOLOGY; INVENT NO HUMANOID ANATOMY OR FACIAL CHANNELS.
reference_guide_lines: IDENTITY AUTHORITY ONLY: MATCH BASE CONFIGURATION, TOPOLOGY, COUNT, PROPORTIONS, LANDMARKS, COLORS, AND MATERIALS.
THE SCENE PROMPT OWNS POSE, STATE, CAMERA, ENVIRONMENT, LIGHTING, AND EVERY DECLARED VARIABLE.

rows.section_label: BASE FORM / UNCOVERED CONFIGURATION: PRIMARY / ORTHOGONAL A / OPPOSITE / ORTHOGONAL B

boxes.label: BASE PRIMARY
boxes.hint: complete unobstructed identity in its neutral canonical configuration and most recognizable orientation; omit detachable coverings, clothing, equipment, and carried modules

boxes.label: BASE ORTHOGONAL A
boxes.hint: complete unobstructed base configuration from a useful orthogonal orientation, preserving exact topology, component count, connections, formation, proportions, and scale from A1

boxes.label: BASE OPPOSITE
boxes.hint: complete unobstructed base configuration from the opposite orientation, proving rear or hidden landmarks, connections, and surface continuity

boxes.label: BASE ORTHOGONAL B
boxes.hint: complete unobstructed base configuration from the second lateral or orthogonal orientation, proving asymmetric presence and absence independently from A2

rows.section_label: BASE FORM / UNCOVERED CONFIGURATION: ABOVE / BELOW

boxes.label: BASE ABOVE
boxes.hint: orthogonal view from above the primary axis of the same uncovered configuration; show the outline, top surfaces, and every component visible from above

boxes.label: BASE BELOW
boxes.hint: orthogonal view from below the primary axis of the same uncovered configuration; show the outline, underside surfaces, and every component visible from below

rows.section_label: DRESSED / COVERED / SHELLED / EQUIPPED CONFIGURATION: SAME STARTER VIEWS

boxes.label: EQUIPPED PRIMARY
boxes.hint: same orientation, topology, and proportions as A1 with the declared covering, outfit, shell, equipment, or carried assembly applied consistently

boxes.label: EQUIPPED ORTHOGONAL A
boxes.hint: same orthogonal orientation, topology, and proportions as A2 with identical declared covering or equipment; show attachment and layer relationships

boxes.label: EQUIPPED OPPOSITE
boxes.hint: same opposite orientation, topology, and proportions as A3 with identical declared covering or equipment; show rear construction and attachment points

boxes.label: EQUIPPED ORTHOGONAL B
boxes.hint: same second lateral or orthogonal orientation as A4 with identical declared covering or equipment; prove asymmetric attachment and absence independently from B2

boxes.label: PROFILE
boxes.hint: renderer-owned identity facts from sheet-data.json; do not repaint or add text

boxes.label: COLOR / MATERIAL KEY
boxes.hint: renderer-owned fixed and variable swatches from sheet-data.json; do not repaint or add labels

boxes.label: DECLARED EXTENT
boxes.hint: complete base configuration beside a plain scale indicator for the declared height, length, span, diameter, or other extent; no measurement text

boxes.label: IDENTITY FOCAL DETAIL
boxes.hint: most diagnostic recognition structure at readable scale: face, sensor, emblem, core, pattern junction, formation, or other declared landmark; invent no face

boxes.label: COVERING / EQUIPMENT DETAILS
boxes.hint: declared covering, clothing, shell, equipment, or carried assembly separated into readable components with attachment points and construction visible

rows.section_label: COMMUNICATED-STATE DIFFERENCES: SAME IDENTITY AND TOPOLOGY

boxes.label: STATE EXPRESSION 01
boxes.hint: first declared communicated-state variant using only this identity's actual channels

boxes.label: STATE EXPRESSION 02
boxes.hint: second declared communicated-state variant; change only declared channels

boxes.label: STATE EXPRESSION 03
boxes.hint: third declared communicated-state variant; change only declared channels

boxes.label: STATE EXPRESSION 04
boxes.hint: fourth declared communicated-state variant; change only declared channels

boxes.label: STATE EXPRESSION 05
boxes.hint: fifth declared communicated-state variant; change only declared channels

boxes.label: STATE EXPRESSION 06
boxes.hint: sixth declared communicated-state variant; change only declared channels

rows.section_label: POSE / ORIENTATION / FORMATION AND BODY-LANGUAGE DIFFERENCES

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 01
boxes.hint: first declared posture, orientation, formation, gesture, or configuration state

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 02
boxes.hint: second declared posture, orientation, formation, gesture, or configuration state

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 03
boxes.hint: third declared posture, orientation, formation, gesture, or configuration state

boxes.label: BODY LANGUAGE 04
boxes.hint: fourth declared posture, orientation, formation, gesture, or configuration state

boxes.label: SIGNATURE ITEMS / MODULES
boxes.hint: each declared stable item or detachable module separately at readable scale
